clips.title: The story
paras: In the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff, Clarice Foster keeps a bitter reminder of the family she lost. Her pendant came from her former husband, Yuriv, whose devotion to the Light left Clarice and their children behind.

Clarice's Pendant recalls the life Clarice Foster lost before she became Forsaken. Before the Third War consumed Lordaeron, her husband Yuriv left her and their children to fight the undead. He believed devotion to the Holy Light came before all else. Yuriv died, and his family was left to fall to the very Scourge he had set out to fight. Clarice does not treasure the pendant he gave her. To her, it is an insult, a reminder that she and the children came second to his zeal and duty.
